text:
sara_ml: heads up — during canary of aurora-30b-int4 we saw repeated latency bursts and occasional OOMs under short bursty traffic (lots of tiny requests). Digging in now, but suspect batch pacing + allocator fragmentation.

ajay_dev: thanks — can you paste the logs / config? is this on dedicated or hosted canary?

sara_ml: hosted canary in us-west-2, pool-aurora-canary-3. snippet of the OOMs: 
```
2023-11-12 15:21:03.452 ERROR infer: OOM while allocating KV cache 128MB on device 0
2023-11-12 15:21:03.453 WARN runtime: falling back to small-batch mode
```
Also saw sudden 200–400ms p99 spikes for otherwise ~40ms tail.

kevin_r: rough hypothesis — during bursts continuous-batching tries to pack many short requests, causing big transient allocations (KV + prefetched chunks) and then GPU memory fragmentation. We saw similar on nova27b.

jen_sre: are max_new_tokens or max_batch_size being enforced by the routing policy? small requests shouldn't get packed if they have tight latency SLOs.

ajay_dev: current route config: 
```
batching: {enabled: true, max_batch_size: 32, max_latency_ms: 50, pacing: "aggressive"}
kv_prefetch: true
quant_profile: int4
```
Pacing aggressive was an experiment to maximize throughput for this pool.

sara_ml: reproducer attached (short requests spammed): results show memory footprint jumps, then GC/evict thrash.

infra-bot: Canary pool-aurora-canary-3: observed 12 OOM events in last 10m, average p99 latency 420ms, baseline 38ms.

tomas_infra: quick mitigation idea — switch pacing to "burst-aware" (limit max_concurrent_batches, add inter-batch cooldown) + lower max_batch_size to 8 for canary. Also try allocator hint: "compact_after_eviction: true" for that runtime so freed KV pages return to pool.

kevin_r: + run a small eval against the quantized model to confirm no quality regression from changing batching. We saw edge-case tokenization shifts when tiny contexts are concatenated in batching.

ajay_dev: commands to patch canary config: 
```
PATCH /pools/aurora-canary-3/config
{
  "batching": {"pacing": "burst-aware", "max_batch_size": 8, "max_latency_ms": 30},
  "allocator": {"compact_after_eviction": true}
}
```
I'll apply in 2m.

sara_ml: also kicked off eval-bot to run smoke quality checks on the same prompt set (100 prompts) to compare int4 outputs vs baseline fp16.

eval-bot: smoke-eval started job id e-20231112-42. Will report rouge/semantic-sim metrics in ~4m.

jen_sre: timeline? if this fixes tail we can roll to more canaries. If not, rollback to previous model variant (aurora-30b-int8).

ajay_dev: patch applied. patch id cfg-8893. Deploy-bot: canary config update deploying to pool-aurora-canary-3.

deploy-bot: Deployment started for cfg-8893 -> pool-aurora-canary-3 (3/3 nodes).

infra-bot: after patch p99 down to 65ms, OOMs 0 in last 5m. Looks promising.

kevin_r: nice. did smoke-eval return?

eval-bot: smoke-eval complete. Metrics: semantic-sim 0.984 vs baseline 0.989, avg rouge-l delta -0.6. Quick manual check of 10 failure cases — 2 mild rephrasing differences, not factual regressions.

sara_ml: small quality delta expected given int4 + different batching semantics. We should run a more thorough 2k-prompt eval but this is safe to ramp if SLOs hold.

tomas_infra: action items: 1) create ramp policy: gradually increase max_batch_size from 8 -> 16 over 1h if p99 < 100ms and OOM=0, 2) monitor fragmentation metric (gpu_free_pages_ratio) and set allocator compact_after_eviction true by default for aurora family, 3) schedule 2k eval overnight.

ajay_dev: noted. creating rollout job now. rollout id r-20231112-77.

jen_sre: also add a temporary circuit-breaker that forces single-request batches if process memory > 80% to avoid tail spikes.

kevin_r: for the longer-term: add a batching heuristic that treats tiny requests (<32 tokens) as latency-sensitive and routes them to a low-burst pool with strict batching disabled. We should A/B that next quarter.

sara_ml: thanks everyone. I'll follow up with the 2k eval results and a postmortem draft if anything regresses. For now marking this canary as stabilized. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Canary cfg-8893 -> pool-aurora-canary-3: success.
